description: One call from 13722 Playa Lucia Court, Houston (hero 199958956, one floor). A teenager alone at home: smoke under a door of 'the room next to the kitchen' (seven rooms are next to the kitchen, so no room is picked), she does not know which exit to use and cannot find the dog. Expected: data/fixtures/calls/expected/s8_playa_lucia.json.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Um, it's... 13722 Playa Lucia Court. There's smoke. There's smoke coming under a door.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay, 13722 Playa Lucia Court. Are you inside the house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes. I'm home by myself. My parents are at work.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Which door is the smoke coming from?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The room next to the kitchen. I don't, I don't know, it's just a door, I never go in there.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Don't open that door. Where are you right now?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm in the hallway. I don't know which way to go, the front door or through the garage, I don't know.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Can you get to a door that goes outside without passing the smoke?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I... I think so? I can't see good, it's getting hazy.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: And I can't find Biscuit, my dog, he was right here...

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Leave the dog for now. Get yourself outside, okay? Stay low.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay. Okay. The alarm just started going off.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: That's good, keep going. Tell me when you're outside.
